name: Ca tai tuong chien xu
summary: A whole elephant-ear fish fried in plenty of oil until it is evenly golden, then pulled apart at the table and rolled with herbs, rice paper, and bún. Dip it in mắm nêm or tamarind fish sauce.
origin: Cù lao Thới Sơn, on the orchard table across the river from Mỹ Tho.
texture: Fried evenly in deep oil so it cooks through, the fish comes out golden.
howToEat: Cooks clean the fish, soak it in salt water for about 15 minutes, drain it, and fry it in a pan with plenty of oil.
Roll pieces in rice paper with herbs and bún, and dip them in mắm nêm or nước mắm me.
where: Order it at the midday orchard stop on cù lao Thới Sơn, about 6 km from Mỹ Tho, with the fruit and the music.
seoTitle: Ca tai tuong chien xu on Thoi Son
seoDescription: Fried elephant-ear fish on Thới Sơn, rolled with herbs, rice paper, and bún, and dipped in mắm nêm or tamarind fish sauce.
